_note: The drive rule (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 2.3): every reply except care (and a student who said stop) ends with the next step, one question or one concrete action. The phase comes from the counselor journey stage. In a phase that asks, a reply allowed a question gets the next bank question, else the next missing education basic (basic_question); otherwise the phase line, a concrete action that names a workspace place. markers are words that show a reply already names that next step (a question mark always counts). The line is English; it is shown in the student's language through the rendered copy cache.

getting_to_know.line: Your Profile page shows what I know about you so far; tell me more about yourself whenever you like.

mirror.line: Open your Mirror and tell me what feels right and what feels wrong.

proposed.line: Your fields are on the Roadmap page: open it and pick the one you want to look at first.

chosen.line: Your next step is on the Roadmap page: open your route and do the first open step.
